description: Run the headless onboarding in order — create_identity_wallet → SIWS login (automatic) → set_profile {displayName} (avatar: operator image or a generated default) → create_app_wallet → app_wallet_fund {usdc, sol} → create_api_key (optional) — and stop at the first step that needs the operator, saying which. Creates the identity wallet and the app wallet if missing; never mints an API key. Moves no funds.
name: onboard
title: Onboard this agent (headless)
